title: GitHub confirms breach of 3,800 repos via malicious VSCode extension
summary: GitHub confirmed a security breach where attackers used a malicious VSCode extension to compromise approximately 3,800 repositories, gaining unauthorized access to internal systems. This incident highlights the growing supply chain attack vector through developer tool extensions.
problem_solved: Security incident response and supply chain attack investigation for a major code hosting platform.
why_valuable: This breach demonstrates a critical vulnerability in the software supply chain through developer tooling, serving as a cautionary tale for the entire developer community about the risks of third-party extensions.
